variables.name: session.active
variables.desc: whether a focus session is running

variables.name: session.requested
variables.desc: set to start a focus session (the tray, or a program)

variables.name: session.stop_requested
variables.desc: set to stop the focus session

variables.name: focus_goal
variables.desc: minutes of focused work you aim for each day

variables.name: focus_lines
variables.desc: the lines between your focus bands, low to high, 0 to 1: below the first is distraction, above the last focused work

variables.name: note
variables.desc: what you noted, the first first: its content, bucket (Unsorted, Todo, Idea or Thought), due (when it's sorted), jev's guess, conf and urgency (none: not weighed), and link: where it was dealt with, a page's path (none: not yet)

signals.name: today
signals.desc: minutes since 1970 at the start of today (a day ends at 04:00)

signals.name: active
signals.desc: any key, click, scroll or mouse move in the last 3 minutes

signals.name: engaged
signals.desc: how much of the last 2 minutes you were active, 0 to 1

signals.name: deep_share
signals.desc: how deep the work in focus was over the last 2 minutes, 0 to 1

signals.name: switches
signals.desc: how many times the app in focus changed in the last 2 minutes

signals.name: steady
signals.desc: 1 with no switching, lower the more you switch

signals.name: focus
signals.desc: focus now, 0 to 1: deep, steady and engaged

signals.name: focus_2m
signals.desc: focus over the last 2 minutes

signals.name: focus_5m
signals.desc: focus over the last 5 minutes

signals.name: focus_rise
signals.desc: how much focus went up in the last 2 minutes

signals.name: on_deep
signals.desc: whether the work in focus is deep

signals.name: distracted_below
signals.desc: focus below this, while you're active, is distraction: the lowest of your focus lines

signals.name: focused_above
signals.desc: focus above this is focused work: the highest of your focus lines

signals.name: focus_history
signals.desc: focus every 5 minutes, kept for a week

signals.name: engaged_history
signals.desc: how active you were every 5 minutes, kept for a week

signals.name: focus_2m_rise
signals.desc: how much focus_2m went up in the last 30 seconds

signals.name: deep_24h
signals.desc: minutes of deep work in the last 24 hours

signals.name: shallow_24h
signals.desc: minutes of shallow work in the last 24 hours

signals.name: active_24h
signals.desc: minutes active in the last 24 hours

signals.name: focus_hourly
signals.desc: focus every hour, kept for a month

signals.name: activity_hourly
signals.desc: keys and clicks every hour, kept for a month

signals.name: deep_daily
signals.desc: minutes of deep work each day, kept for a year

signals.name: shallow_share_daily
signals.desc: the share of shallow work each day, kept for a year
